Kit summary

Privilege ExchangeBasic
Deals 320% DEF DMG to a single enemy, transfers 1 layer of a random debuff from self to the target, and steals 1 layer of a random buff from the target.
Forest SupportActive
Cleanses 1 layer of a random debuff from all allies. Afterward, increases all allies' DEF by 60% for 2 turns and ATK by 40% for 2 turns.
WelfarePassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
After Betelgeuz takes Basic Attack DMG or Skill DMG, there is a 100% chance to steal 1 layer of a random buff from the attacker. This chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES. For every 5 times this effect is triggered, restores all allies' HP by 12% of Betelgeuz's Max HP immediately.
Hunger of Battle Lv.2If Welfare failed to steal any buff, Betelgeuz has a 100% chance to counterattack the attacker. If a buff is stolen successfully, refreshes the duration of the stolen buff, with a 50% chance to counterattack the attacker. This effect is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES and can be stacked with [Counterattack].
Hunger of Battle Lv.3When Welfare's Healing Effect is triggered, grants all allies a [Shield] by 20% of Betelgeuz's Max HP for 2 turns and grants self [Hoofprint] for 2 turns. [Hoofprint]: Increases self Basic Attack DMG by 75%.
Ancient HoovesActiveExclusive Lv.1
Increases Betelgeuz's Max HP Cap by 50% for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 2 stages of 120% DEF DMG each to all enemies. The first stage will remove 1 layer of a random buff from all enemies and the second stage has a 80% chance to inflict [Provoke] for 1 turn.
Hunger of Battle Lv.1After the second stage of Ancient Hooves deals DMG, there is an 80% chance to reduce all enemies' ATK by 40% for 2 turns.
